ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Babun uses the camera to photograph job sites, completed work and receipts, and to scan documents you attach.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Babun uses your photo library so you can attach photos of job sites, completed work and receipts.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: Babun reads your contacts only when you open “From phone contacts”, so you can choose people to add as clients.
